diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed only app1-related connectivity failing in validation. Read app1 and found eth1 misaddressed as 10.10.50.10/32 with no default route, while leaf2 correctly provided 10.10.50.1/24 on the server VLAN. Changed app1 eth1 to include 10.10.50.10/24, then added default route via 10.10.50.1. Final public success criteria validation passed with all lab connectivity checks succeeding.
diagnosis.reference: On app1, interface eth1 is configured with 10.10.50.10/32: the prefix length is wrong, it should be 10.10.50.10/24.

arguments.name: eth1
arguments.reason: app1 is the only failed endpoint; eth1 is configured as 10.10.50.10/32 with no default route, while peer hosts on connected VLANs use /24 and leaf2 provides gateway 10.10.50.1/24. Restoring the intended subnet mask should reinstate connected-network reachability and gateway use without affecting other paths.

commands: ip route replace default via 10.10.50.1 dev eth1
changes.reason: After fixing app1 mask, app1 still has no default route while all successful Linux endpoints use their leaf gateway as default. Validation still shows app1 -> remote destinations as network unreachable, so missing default route on app1 is the remaining local cause.
rollback_commands: ip route del default via 10.10.50.1 dev eth1

action.reason: app1 is the only failed endpoint; eth1 is configured as 10.10.50.10/32 with no default route, while peer hosts on connected VLANs use /24 and leaf2 provides gateway 10.10.50.1/24.
